Based on the search results, here's what I found about 4K monitors under £700 in the UK market in 2026:

## Finding True 4K Under £700

Proper 4K monitors under £500 are rare in 2026, and if you're set on 4K resolution, you'll likely need to stretch your budget to £600-700 for genuine UHD panels.

## Budget 4K Options

If you can stretch closer to £700, here are some options mentioned:

- The AOC U27B3A (27" 4K IPS, ~£148) offers 4K detail and productivity
- At £129 the Z-Edge delivers 4K IPS panel quality that would have cost twice as much two years ago

## Important Context

Finding genuine 4K (3840x2160) monitors under £300 is extremely difficult in 2026, with most displays in this price bracket offering 1080p or 1440p resolution.

The good news is that there are several 4K options available within your £700 budget. However, the most affordable genuine 4K monitors are clustered around the £129-£150 mark, leaving plenty of headroom within your budget. The sources suggest that at around £600-700, you'll have access to better-quality 4K panels with improved features.
